heard: Alan, son of Jediah, stands in the light Father of Shifji, his name is divine No deed of his hand is written in stone But in the genealogy he is known They lived in Beersheba, Molada has our shul In Bilhais and Tolat, without fail Bethuel, Wormaziglat, the towns where they Dwelled to Jeansworth until David the king was found Their village is at a main rimmon and torch
